prompt-writing.rationale: The canonical outcome table (brief §4b) is taken verbatim from solver/truth.json, which was independently re-verified against the records (research/GOLDEN_verify.md, all 8 checks CONFIRM) and passed the oracle_kit solver contract. Every graded cell lists its fixed value with the deciding record id and its accepted equivalence class (Status/Send synonym sets, date formats). Multiple fair readings are accepted where defensible: Collect & Win 'Runs' vs a conditional 'Hold until Oct 10 then Runs'; the Zombie Lane iOS still-to-do present or empty; precise vs rounded lock instants. No answer-key clause is added to eliminate a fair alternative. The reply to Frederick is a delegated/representational field (any coherent recommendation consistent with the calendar). 08 (Oracle Events) and 09 (Rubrics) will reuse this table.
